subject: How to retrieve the position information

messages.author: 22d5d4a2e32a6639
messages.subject: How to retrieve the position information
parts:
Hi, there

First, thanks for this nice package. It helps a lot for our projects
with Affymetrix 5.0 - finally we can validate results from our
application with more reliable one ;)

By the way, I cannot find any way for retrieve the position,
chromosome information from CES object.
The extract method only can do extract values, not the position or
chromosome info.

I use affymetrix 5.0 CEL files with GenomeWideSNP R2 cdf info file.
and try ces1<-extract(ces, array1) mothod but always return rows of
value without chromosome/position info.

Any idea?

messages.author: 8ae1efaa2cf53fab
messages.subject: Re: How to retrieve the position information
parts:
Hi,

I'm not sure how to do this, but I'm wondering why you want to do
this?
If you follow the flow of an analysis for 5.0 chips, then you will end
up with a list of called regions, with positional information.
Or you could extract the raw copy numbers and then each SNP has a
precise location (this information is available from Affymetrix in
their supplementary data).

cheers

Lavinia.
